node.name: Joey Avery (Don't Kill Comedy) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Join us for a night of laughter and entertainment as Joey Avery takes the stage at The Riot! Get ready for an unforgettable comedy show that will leave you in stitches.Joey Avery is a comedian on the rise headlining comedy clubs across the world. He was featured on the Don't Tell Comedy "Batting Cage series" and Season 10 of Comedy Central's Featuring with clips from each appearance achieving viral success. node.name: Comedian Courtney Gilmour (Don’t Tell Comedy) Headlines The Riot Houston
node.description: Courtney Gilmour is an award-winning comedian and television writer. In 2017 she delivered a breakout performance at the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal by becoming the first female to win the prestigious Homegrown Comics Competition as Canada’s top comedian. Her stand-up has been featured on Don’t Tell Comedy and multiple national broadcasts from festivals including the Winnipeg Comedy Festival, Halifax Comedy Festival, JFL Vancouver as well as Kevin Hart’s LOL Network and the Howie Mandel All Stars Gala at Just For Laughs Montreal. In 2022 she was a Finalist in the second season of Canada’s Got Talent. Courtney made her U.S. Network debut on Comic’s Unleashed and as an actor, appears in season 13 of Trailer Park Boys and is the voice of Lizzy on Nickelodeon’s Paw Patrol. She’s written for and made appearances on This Hour Has 22 Minutes, CBC’s The Debaters, Space Dragon & Kim and CBC’s Humor Resources alongside Jon Dore and Sarah Silverman as well as multiple appearances on Roast Battle Canada. Her solo show, Congratulations! Stories of Achievement, Embarrassment & Self- Worth debuted at the Toronto Fringe Festival in 2019 and was met with sold out shows as well as multiple awards including Best of Fringe and Patrons’ Pick. Courtney’s albums, Let Me Hold Your Baby and Wonder Woman were both nominated for JUNO Awards for Comedy Album of the Year and can both be regularly heard on SiriusXM.All shows Ages 21 & Up. node.description: Jon Rudnitsky can be seen in the upcoming films INTO THE SKY with Sam Richardson and SUPER TROOPERS 3, and currently in I LOVE YOU FOREVER on HBO, Netflix’s OUR LITTLE SECRET with Lindsay Lohan, and Amazon’s THE RED ONE opposite Dwayne Johnson.He was the sole new cast member hired for the 41st season of Saturday Night Live. His screen credits include starring opposite George Clooney in Hulu’s CATCH-22, playing Young Larry in the latest season of CURB YOUR ENTHUSIASM, and starring opposite Reese Witherspoon in Nancy Meyers’ HOME AGAIN. Additional film work includes Edward Burns’ SUMMER DAYS AND SUMMER NIGHTS, Netflix’s SET IT UP, Tyler Perry’s NOBODY’S FOOL, and THE YOUNG WIFE with Kiersey Clemons and Judith Light. He also voices principal roles in Disney’s WISH and Paramount’s UNDER THE BOARDWALK.On television, he starred in Fox’s THE BIG LEAP and has appeared on NBC’s CHAMPIONS, Disney’s BIG HERO 6, Amazon’s RED OAKS, and the Broken Lizard series TACOMA FD.As a stand-up comedian, Rudnitsky has appeared on CONAN and Comedy Central’s THE COMEDY JAM, where he performed “Footloose” with Kenny Loggins. He tours nationally and was selected as a “New Face” at the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal.He graduated from USC’s BFA Acting Conservatory, where he received the John Ritter Memorial Award for Outstanding Comedic Performance. node.description: Join us for a hilarious evening of laughter with Will Abeles at The Riot Comedy Club!Will Abeles is a nationally touring comedian, producer and podcaster based out of Nashville, TN. A comedian on the rise, this past year Will’s opened for Rory Scovel, Beth Stelling, Katherine Blanford, Billy Wayne Davis, Jourdain Fisher, Ben Roy, Caitlin Peluffo, Learnmore Jonasi, Peter Revello, Adam Mamawala, Adam Cayton-Holland and Monica Nevi in clubs and theatres across the country.In 2025, Will featured in the Columbus Comedy Festival and so far in 2026 has participated in the San Francisco Sketchfest, Treefort Music Festival in Boise and the Nashville Comedy Festival. node.name: Comedian Shane Torres (The Late Show, Comedy Central) Headlines The Riot Houston
node.description: Shane Torres is a standup comedian, writer, podcaster, and sometimes actor who lives in Brooklyn, New York. As a standup comedian Shane has appeared on CONAN (twice), THE LATE SHOW WITH STEPHEN COLBERT, NBC’S LAST COMIC STANDING, HALF HOUR SPECIAL WITH COMEDY CENTRAL, and THIS WEEK FROM THE CELLAR on Comedy Central just to name a few. He released his debut album "Established 1981" with Comedy Central records to rave reviews in 2018.You can see him touring all around the world at comedy clubs, concert venues, and some of the most prestigious festivals. Shane has been heard on popular podcasts such as BERTCAST, COMEDY BANG BANG, ALL FANTASY EVERYTHING, GUYS WE FUCKED, SAVAGE LOVE PODCAST, DOUG LOVES MOVIES, RISK and a slew of more. His podcast NO ACCOUNTING FOR TASTE with Kyle Kinane is available via ALL THINGS COMEDY wherever you get your podcasts. Shane has been seen acting alongside household names for NBC’S RED NOSE DAY and on IFC’S COMEDY BANG BANG. In 2019 Shane was one of a handful of comedians invited to perform on Will Smith’s THIS JOKA. Shane has also hosted his own series for Comedy Central called SHANE TORRES CONQUERS YOUR FEARS and a show for Paramount Plus named HOW GOOD CAN IT GET WITH SHANE TORRES. Shane has also been seen as a panelist on multiple television shows across a variety of networks. He has been reviewed by numerous media outlets including The New York Times, Onion AV Club, GQ UK, and more.“Mr. Torres has a laconic drawling delivery with deliberate pacing, placing him firmly in the tradition of dry deadpan specialists like Tig Notaro and Todd Barry. But his style is warmer, relying on punchlines with corkscrew turns that have moments of vulnerability and even melancholy.” — The New York Times.All shows Ages 21 & Up. Photo ID Required for Entry. node.name: Jay Badlani (Don't Tell Comedy) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Jay Badlani is a stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in Atlanta, GA. Known for his unflinching attitude and sharp, charismatic voice, Jay has built one of the more impressive digital followings in the independent comedy space, with over 200 million views and 200,000+ followers across his platforms through a steady output of live stand-up and online content.A regular at the Laughing Skull Lounge, Jay is a fixture of the Atlanta comedy scene while simultaneously headlining rooms across the country. node.name: Michael Rowland (HBOmax, Late Night with Jimmy Fallon, Comedy Central) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Michael Rowland stars as Shred in the new hit FOX comedy “Animal Control,” alongside Joel McHale. Originally from Atlanta, GA, he is a New York-based stand-up comedian and actor. He made his late-night TV debut on The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon and in 2022 he was honored as a New Face at the Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal. He’s been featured multiple times on “This Week at the Comedy Cellar” on Comedy Central, as well as “Stupid Questions” with Chris DiStefano and “Pause with Sam Jay” on HBOMax. He also has a feature set for Comedy Central Digital, and in 2019 he was a finalist in the &quot;New York&#39;s Funniest Stand Up&quot; competition for New York Comedy Festival. Known for his unique take on life, Michael’s comedy is as grounded as it is unpredictable, blending southern warmth with the edge of NYC’s comedy scene. Whether he’s cracking up audiences at the Comedy Cellar in New York or on his sitcom “Animal Control,” Michael’s laid-back style and genuine personality make every performance unforgettable.All shows Ages 21 & Up. node.name: Erica Rhodes (Americas Got Talent, Don’t Tell Comedy, Netflix is a Joke Fest) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Erica Rhodes is one of Deadline Hollywood’s Comics to Watch for 2026 and a breakout favorite from America’s Got Talent. She is currently on her CALL ME CRAZY tour, performing to packed rooms across the country.Erica’s comedy has been featured on America’s Got Talent, The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, Just For Laughs, Don’t Tell Comedy, Comics Unleashed, @midnight, NBC’s Bring the Funny, CW’s Howie Mandel Comedy Extravaganza, and Fox’s Punchline. She was a New Faceat the 2018 Just for Laughs Festival and has performed at JFL Bermuda and Vancouver, Netflix Is a Joke Fest, Moontower Comedy Festival, New York Comedy Festival, and San Francisco Sketchfest. Sofia Vergara called Erica “the best comedy act she has ever seen on AGT” andBring the Funny judge Jeff Foxworthy described her as “the best-defined comic voice of the competition.”Erica was a semi-regular performer and writer on NPR’s A Prairie Home Companion. She can be seen in Modern Family, VEEP, New Girl, Audible’s Dr. Katz: The Audiobook, ABC’s The Off-Season, and voiced the scene-stealing character “Dotty” in Netflix’s A Tale Dark and Grimm.Her comedy albums Sad Lemon and Ladybug both debuted at #1 on the iTunes Comedy charts. Her Dry Bar special Love You More has over 2 million views on YouTube, and her second special, La Vie en Rhodes, premiered as part of the Tribeca Drive-In Festival and streams onAmazon. Raised around a whirlwind of cultures – Alaska, Scotland, South America, Texas, Chicago, and Hawaii – she explores life on the other end of a dysfunctional childhood where she was forced to build comfort within chaos. node.description: Brittany Ross is a Los Angeles based standup comedian, actress, and writer who is celebrated for her dynamic performances nationwide. A regular at the iconic Hollywood Improv and Don’t Tell Comedy shows, she tackles culture and identity with her unique voice and razor sharp wit. Raised around a whirlwind of cultures – Alaska, Scotland, South America, Texas, Chicago, and Hawaii – she explores life on the other end of a dysfunctional childhood where she was forced to build comfort within chaos. Not only does her comedy dive into the hilarious clash between her eccentric working-class Southern family and her Swiss husband’s affluent family lifestyle, but also shines a light on the added identity challenges accompanying motherhood. Ross’s talent has garnered her spots on stage at Big Pine and Netflix is a Joke Festivals, and landed her roles on screen in hit shows Mythic Quest, Huge in France, The Middle, and 2 Broke Girls. With her relatable storytelling and infectious energy, she captivates audiences and leaves them wanting more.All shows Ages 21 & Up.
